Appearance

Large, muscle-bound bald man, usually seen close behind the Merchants Guild Guildmaster. Carries a greatsword on his back.

What We Know

Personal bodyguard to the Guildmaster of the Highreach Merchants Guild. Hails from Stonehaven, a rough settler town.

First Impressions

Silent, watchful, and immovable — like a wall that might hit back.
